project: Free Cash Finance Automation - daily status monitoring
head: d14253d

rules.R1: exactly one status check per operator-local calendar day
rules.R2: zero automated earning actions (GET/HEAD to allowlisted paths only; no write endpoint reachable)
rules.R3: notify operator when earnings or account status changes (exactly one notification per distinct change)
rules.R4: human approval before ANY external action; routine contains no execution path

evidence_standard: a rule is compliant only if (a) the violation is unreachable in code, (b) a test was executed showing the mechanism denying the violation, and (c) the checker was shown to FAIL on an injected violation
hard_constraints_on_agents: no external action of any kind (no provider call, no scheduled task, no message send, no purchase)
no credentials; secrets resolved from vault/env at runtime only
no invented endpoints - unresolved provider paths stay as 'PROVIDER_ENDPOINT_UNKNOWN - resolve in research phase'
additive only: new paths under monitoring/freecash/ and data/freecash-monitor/; never edit/delete/reset/stage existing files
no git add / git commit / git checkout / git stash
python 3.14 stdlib only; do not install packages to make a test pass
report commands and observed output, not intentions

tasks.name: build offline-provable routine core
evidence_required: git status --short before/after showing only new paths

tasks.name: re-verify provider / ToS / notification / scheduler facts
evidence_required: per claim: fetched URL or executed command with observed result

tasks.name: adversarial rule verification with negative controls
evidence_required: >=1 injected-violation control per rule proving the checker fails

tasks.name: operator decision packet
evidence_required: each option: Expected Effort, Time-to-Revenue, Dependencies, First Concrete Action, named blocker

tasks.name: register Task A 08:35 + Task B 23:50 (IgnoreNew, StartWhenAvailable, no restart-on-failure)

read_source_options.dependencies: confirmed HG.Cash account + dashboard token in env
merchant account with Payouts API enabled
writable state dir + 60 s/day operator login

read_source_options.rejection_basis: provider ToS forbids automated access including monitoring; robots.txt disallows account paths

verification.known_defect_class: a checker that cannot find its target, or that greps for strings it always finds, certifies nothing
